articles.summary: An HR strategy is your plan for how hiring, benefits, compliance, and retention support your business goals. This guide explains what an HR strategy is, why a small business needs one, and how to build yours step by step with a simple framework. You’ll leave with a clear path from goals to execution, plus a template to start from.
articles.title: HR Strategy for Small Business: How to Build One Step by Step

articles.summary: Business succession planning is the process of deciding who will own and who will lead a company when the current owner or key leaders step away. This guide covers the succession process step by step, the four common ways to transfer a business, family business considerations, and how to prepare successors. You’ll come away with a plan outline considerations and a checklist template that may help you begin thinking through a succession plan.
articles.title: Business Succession Planning: A Complete Guide for Small Businesses

articles.summary: A leave of absence (LOA) is an approved, extended period away from work for circumstances that fall outside regular paid time off, such as a serious health condition, welcoming or bonding with a new child, or military service. This guide covers the laws that protect leave, who qualifies, pay during leave, and how to handle requests.
articles.title: Leave of Absence: Types, Laws & Employer Guide | TriNet
